messages:
kai: FYI I'm seeing a weird NVMe metadata write surge in us-west2 that's blocking about a dozen GPU attaches. IOPS look small-writes heavy but metadata ops are through the roof :sweat:
infra-bot: [ALERT] region=us-west2 metric=nvme_metadata_ops spike=+420% nodes=gnode-uw2-58..66
ana: any recent rollout? could be a logging change or tmp cleanup running in lockstep
kai: yes, devex pushed logging-agent v2.2 yesterday which switched to per-request temporary files under /var/tmp/app-logs/* — looks like a rename-heavy pattern hitting overlayfs
devex-bot: note: logging-agent v2.2 changed rotate to write-to-temp + atomic rename to avoid partial logs
omar: atomic rename pattern on overlayfs can cause metadata amplification; overlayfs updates upperdir metadata and dentry churn can spike small metadata writes on the backing device
lina: practical mitigations? we can't revert devex change org-wide instantly
kai: rolling a 1hr mitigation: reduce logging-agent workers on affected nodes, bump tmp retention so fewer churn deletions, and throttle janitor for nodes with high nvme metadata ops
ana: paste commands please
kai: ran: kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/logging-agent WORKERS=2 --context=us-west2
kai: and: kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner CONCURRENCY=2 --context=us-west2
kai: also applied a tmpfiles.d tweak via ssh script to increase /var/tmp retention from 10m -> 60m on gnode-uw2-58..66 (manual for now)
infra-bot: [METRIC] us-west2 nvme_metadata_ops 1m=+85% 5m=+210% 15m=+18%
omar: initial numbers promising — 1m ops dropped ~40% after throttles. but overlayfs keeps higher tail latency; this cohort has older firmware and higher P/E cycles so it's noisier
lina: cost note: stalled attaches ~12 gpus * avg wait 35m -> ~420 gpu-minutes. tag finance for exact $ impact if we escalate
ana: medium-term fixes: (1) change logging-agent to append-in-place instead of rename where safe, (2) add an attach-priority semaphore so cleaners/loggers yield to attach paths, (3) schedule logger rollouts with node canaries
devex-bot: devex team: will open PR to make rename behavior behind feature flag and add canary rollout. starting with canary=2 nodes next deploy
omar: ops follow-ups: add nvme_metadata_ops to alert runbook thresholds and automatic cleaner throttle when ops > 200% baseline and attach_backlog > 3
kai: filed INFRA-7810 "overlayfs rename churn -> nvme metadata amplification" assigned to eng-infra + devex. owners: kai (ops), devex:ana (flag PR), omar (telemetry)
lina: cool. monitoring now — current nvme_metadata_ops 1m +48% and attach backlog down to 4. will watch 90m before closing thread
ana: thanks, updating devex ticket and rolling back rename flag if we see re-regressions :thumbsup:
kai: thanks all — nice coordination, closing unless it flares back up
